description: This Kotlin source file defines factory objects for creating ViewModel instances in an Android app, specifically for note listing and note editing functionalities. It includes methods to produce ViewModelProvider.Factory objects tailored for each ViewModel, using a repository as a dependency.

classes.name: ViewModelFactories
classes.description: A singleton object providing factory methods to create ViewModelProvider.Factory instances for different ViewModels used in the app.

methods.name: notesList
methods.description: Creates a ViewModelProvider.Factory that produces a NotesListViewModel, injecting the provided NotesRepository.

methods.name: noteEditor
methods.description: Creates a ViewModelProvider.Factory that produces a NoteEditorViewModel, injecting the NotesRepository and an optional note ID.
